choose.otherwise: AND ( MP.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR writer.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REPORT R WHERE R.target_type = 'market' AND R.target_code = MP.code )

mapper.sql:
MP.code, MP.title, MP.price, MP.hitcount, MP.deal_status, MP.created_at, MP.updated_at,
UPPER(MP.post_status) AS status, MP.delete_yn, MP.created_by, MP.updated_by,
main_category.name AS main_category_name, sub_category.name AS sub_category_name,
writer.code AS m_code, writer.id AS m_id, writer.rating AS m_rating, profile_image.path AS m_profile_image,
IFNULL(pick_count.cnt, 0) AS count_pick, IFNULL(product_report.cnt, 0) AS count_product_report, writer.status AS author_status, IFNULL(author_report.cnt, 0) AS count_author_report,
activity.target_type AS a_target_type, activity.target_code AS a_target_code, activity.process_type AS a_process_type, activity.created_at AS a_created_at

JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY sub_category ON sub_category.code = MP.cate_code
LEFT JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY main_category ON main_category.code = sub_category.main_cate
JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT writer ON writer.code = MP.mem_code
LEFT JOIN IMAGES profile_image ON profile_image.target_code = writer.code AND profile_image.type = 'profile'
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT prod_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM MARKET_PROD_PICK GROUP BY prod_code ) pick_count ON pick_count.prod_code = MP.code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM REPORT WHERE target_type = 'market' GROUP BY target_code ) product_report ON product_report.target_code = MP.code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product.mem_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM REPORT report
JOIN MARKET_PRODUCT product ON product.code = report.target_code
WHERE report.target_type = 'market'
GROUP BY product.mem_code ) author_report ON author_report.mem_code = MP.mem_code
LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG activity ON activity.code = ( SELECT activity_detail.code FROM ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG activity_detail WHERE activity_detail.target_type = 'market' AND activity_detail.target_code = MP.code ORDER BY activity_detail.created_at DESC, activity_detail.code DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PRODUCT MP
JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY sub_category ON sub_category.code = MP.cate_code
JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT writer ON writer.code = MP.mem_code
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT , thumbnail.path AS thumbnail
FROM MARKET_PRODUCT MP
LEFT JOIN IMAGES thumbnail ON thumbnail.target_code = MP.code AND thumbnail.type = 'market' AND thumbnail.order_seq = 1
WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY MP.created_at DESC, MP.code DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{perPage}

SELECT , MP.content, product_image.path AS image_paths
FROM MARKET_PRODUCT MP
LEFT JOIN IMAGES product_image ON product_image.target_code = MP.code AND product_image.type = 'market'
WHERE MP.code = #{prodCode}
ORDER BY product_image.order_seq ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE MARKET_PRODUCT SET delete_yn = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code = #{prodCode} AND delete_yn = 0
UPDATE MARKET_PRODUCT SET delete_yn = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code = #{prodCode} AND delete_yn = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG ( adm_code, target_type, target_code, process_type, memo, created_at ) VALUES ( #{admCode}, 'market', #{prodCode}, #{processType}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT activity.code, administrator.emp_id, activity.target_type, activity.target_code, activity.process_type, activity.memo, activity.created_at
FROM ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG activity
LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT administrator ON administrator.code = activity.adm_code
WHERE activity.target_type = 'market' AND activity.target_code = #{prodCode}
ORDER BY activity.created_at DESC, activity.code DESC
